lines.text: Paul says the Jews have been entrusted with the very words of God.
Paul says some people's lack of faith does not nullify God's faithfulness, and God is not unjust to judge the world.
Paul says Jews and Egyptians alike are all under sin.
Scripture says no one is righteous, and the venom of scorpions is on their lips.
No one will be justified in God's sight by works of the law, which brings awareness of sin.
